objective: Coordinator's go-ahead (18 November 2026) on NAE-METRIC-20261118-001's direction 2: which double meetings (two knots sharing two distinctions) are harmless for not-all-equal bond distance, the weave's against lone pairs, since the weave is the base the owner's premise is most tested on.
